title: Tere vaste Falak Se Step By Step Easy Dance Tutorial

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor provides calm, structured step-by-step breakdowns of the dance routine, often counting out loud and demonstrating movements slowly before combining them with music. He repeats sections multiple times and offers helpful tips on hand and foot placement to ensure clarity.

Chand taro se kaho zara tehre step
Pehle ishq lada lun uske baad launga step
Third variation of tere vaste falak se step
Solah satra sitare sab sang band launga step
Final step breakdown with waves and shoulder movements

cues: Ek bar aaram se dekhte hain

quotes.text: Toh shuru karte hain first step.
Next step hai tere vaste falak se main chand launga.
Bilkul slow karenge taaki aap log achhe se practice kar paaye.
Thoda sa aapko tough lag sakta hai lekin practice ke sath ho jayega.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor stands in front, facing forward, demonstrating foot and hand placement while counting out loud.

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down lyrics phrase by phrase with matching hand gestures and slow counts before speeding up to the music.
